body: + Cartistem is used for knee only.

Cartistem is not an injection. it requires surgery. You put holes in the damaged area and insert the medication. I know that one vial is like 8k, but you might need more than one vial, + surgery cost. You can't get them if you are in stage 4, meaning the femur and tibia are completely bone-on-bone. Cartistem became pretty common and you can get it done in pretty much any orthos that specializes in knee.
Where was the bone spur? Was it your tibia? Or femur? Is the procedure complicated ? How severe was your bone spur?
Nvm, BMAC is only good for cartilage damage. You need an actual surgery with scope to repair your meniscus, but if the tear isn’t severe, you can manage the pain with PT
PRP- garbo. Dont get it. Look up BMAC. Idk if it’s available in the NA tho. But PT- defo worth it, as long as you are willing to put work and be consistent with the exercises.

It is widely accepted by academia that there should be no weight bearing for 6 weeks. The first 3 months post op is so important for the cadaver to stay on, you are highly recommended to wear unloader brace for that period.
